enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in bed with the air conditioner running to stay cool through the warm night
enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes deeply. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up to chest. Adjusts pillow. Remains still. Turns to right side. Pushes blanket down. Stretches legs. Curls up. Remains asleep. Turns onto back. Places arm over eyes. Snores lightly. Turns to left side again. Pulls blanket over shoulder. Remains still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and taking a quick cool shower before the hot day
enriched_activities.desc: Opens eyes. Sits up. Swings legs out of bed. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on shower. Adjusts water temperature. Steps into shower. Wets body. Applies soap. Rinses body. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Wraps towel around body. Walks to sink. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Wipes face with towel. Walks out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with toast and a kettle-boiled drink, filling a water bottle for the heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Turns on kitchen light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out bread. Takes out plate. Places bread in toaster. Presses toaster lever. Opens cabinet. Takes out mug. Fills kettle with water. Places kettle on base. Turns on kettle. Waits for toast. Toast pops up. Removes toast from toaster. Places toast on plate. Eats toast. Drinks from mug. Fills water bottle from tap. Closes water bottle. Turns off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Puts on shoes. Picks up bag. Opens door. Steps out. Locks door. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Rides bus. Bus stops. Gets off bus. Walks to hospital. Enters hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional on the ward, caring for patients and monitoring heat-related cases
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to ward. Checks patient charts. Washes hands. Enters patient room. Greets patient. Checks vital signs. Adjusts IV drip. Administers medication. Records notes. Washes hands. Exits patient room. Walks to next patient. Checks vital signs. Changes dressing. Administers injection. Updates chart. Washes hands. Responds to call bell. Assists patient to bathroom. Monitors fluid intake. Documents observations.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and rehydrating in the staff area
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to staff area. Sits down. Opens lunch bag. Takes out sandwich. Unwraps sandwich. Eats sandwich. Drinks water from bottle. Refills water bottle. Drinks more water. Wipes mouth with napkin. Throws away trash. Stands up. Walks back to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing the clinical shift, attending to patients and completing charting duties
enriched_activities.desc: Washes hands. Enters patient room. Checks vital signs. Administers medication. Changes IV bag. Records output. Washes hands. Exits patient room. Walks to nurses station. Opens computer. Logs in. Updates patient records. Reviews orders. Prints reports. Files reports. Answers phone. Takes message. Walks to supply room. Restocks gloves. Returns to ward. Assists colleague with patient transfer. Washes hands. Documents transfer.
Picks up bag. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Rides bus. Bus stops. Gets off bus. Walks to home. Opens door. Enters home. Locks door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner while drinking plenty of water
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Turns on kitchen light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables. Takes out chicken. Places vegetables on cutting board. Cuts vegetables. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Adds oil. Adds chicken. Stirs chicken. Adds vegetables. Stirs mixture. Turns off stove. Places food on plate. Sits down. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Refills water glass. Drinks more water. Clears plate. Turns off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower to cool down after the hot commute
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on shower. Adjusts water temperature. Steps into shower. Wets body. Applies soap. Rinses body. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Wraps towel around body. Walks to sink. Turns on tap. Washes face. Turns off tap. Dries face. Walks out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV in the cooled living area
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channel. Watches TV. Adjusts volume. Puts down remote. Watches TV. Shifts position. Picks up remote. Changes channel. Watches TV. Stands up. Walks to kitchen. Gets glass of water. Walks back to living room. Sits on sofa. Drinks water. Puts down glass. Watches TV. Picks up remote. Turns off TV. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to check messages and wind down, running the vacuum cleaner for a quick tidy
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to computer. Sits down. Turns on computer. Opens messaging app. Reads messages. Types reply. Sends message. Closes app. Turns off computer. Stands up. Walks to closet. Opens closet. Takes out vacuum cleaner. Plugs in vacuum. Turns on vacuum. Vacuum floor. Turns off vacuum. Unplugs vacuum. Puts away vacuum. Closes closet.

enriched_activities.activity: Night-time washing and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Uses toilet. Flushes toilet. Washes hands. Turns off tap. Dries hands. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns on tap. Washes face. Turns off tap. Dries face. Changes into pajamas. Walks out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with the air conditioner and fan on to stay comfortable through the hot night
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Turns on air conditioner. Turns on fan. Lies in bed. Pulls blanket up. Closes eyes. Breathes deeply. Turns to left side. Adjusts pillow. Remains still. Turns to right side. Pushes blanket down. Stretches legs. Curls up. Remains asleep.
